claims.claim: PRIMARY wakeup now accepts strictly validated repository-owned repository and unique non-empty GitHub actor bindings while preserving exact event matching, protocol framing, selectors, and sanitized outputs.

REMEDIATION-intent and REPAIR-wakeup now use strictly validated downstream repository and actor bindings while retaining trusted actor equality checks, fixed family markers, strict request schemas, and existing outputs.

Terminal-attention now accepts a validated repository-owned repository binding while preserving exact event binding, main ref, attention namespace, terminal selectors, and notification-only semantics.

Focused regression coverage was added for downstream portability, upstream compatibility, conflicting event bindings, malformed repositories, and empty, duplicate, or malformed actor allowlists across all four carrier families.
